rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPenTestReport

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: republishedBy

Safety risk level.
Use Process defines actions used by elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: testedOn

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: webpage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that can be used to locate a resource, as defined in [RFC 9110](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9110/) Section 4.2.1 or Section 4.2.2. It may include an optional fragment identifier as specified in [RFC 3986](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3986) Section 3.5.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha1

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invokedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element was invoked by the `to` Agent, during a LifecycleScopeType period (for example, a /Build/Build element that describes a build step).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.
Provides advise on how to mitigate or remediate a vulnerability when a VEX product is affected by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier. This may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be used to signal when support ends for the artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM created directly from the development environment, source files, and included dependencies used to build a product artifact.
ResponsibilityChangeProcess refers to the process of transferring responsibility from one party to another.
Specifies a human language used within the content of an Element or a property.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.
A transport route refers to the specific path or network used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: describes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element describes each `to` Element. To denote the root(s) of a tree of elements in a collection, the rootElement property shall be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ownership
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Ownership refers to the legal right to control, manage, and benefit from an asset, resource, or responsibility. It establishes authority, accountability, and entitlements over something, whether it's property, a business, intellectual property, or responsibilities.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cve
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).
A license that is not listed on the SPDX License List.
Provides information about the completeness of relationships.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ark
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Archival Resource Key (ARK)](https://arks.org/about/), is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) suited to being a persistent identifier for information objects of any type, standardized by the [ARK Identifier Scheme](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kunze-ark/) Internet-Draft. It consists of the "ark:" label followed by a Name Assigning Authority Number, a forward slash, a name, and an optional qualifier (e.g., `ark:12148/btv1b8449691v/f29`).
Identifies all the text and metadata associated with a license in the license XML format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsoleted
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Superseded or not valid at present.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where only one of the elements applies.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is documentation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and there is limited support available from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
This process is used to determine the state of an affected Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operatingSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an operating system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: coordinatedBy

A location where a package or an item will be dropped off or delivered.
A name used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.
A reference to a resource identifier defined outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTestCase

Provides a map of a property name to a value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a test used to verify functionality on a software element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a module of a piece of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: asilB

Class that describes a build instance of software/artifacts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha512

Enumeration of the different kinds of SPDX file.

Verification postcondition that are true immediately after a verification method has been performed

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement has been approved by stakeholder, and can be include in traceability.

The CreateProcess refers to the abstract process class that can be used to represent the process of creation of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: install
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is used to install software on disk.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. The use of the `hasAssessmentFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
A tuple of two positive integers that define a range.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: modifiedBy

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha384

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildSystem

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dynamicAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a dynamic analysis report for a package.
An element of hardware and/or software utilized to carry out a particular function.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: formalStandard

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: function
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation the function of the hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gln
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Location Number (GLN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gln) is a 13-digit number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a legal entity (e.g., a company or customer), a function within a legal entity, a physical location (e.g., a warehouse or a specific shelf in a store), or a digital location (e.g., an Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) gateway).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source

Commentary on an assertion that an annotator has made.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amber

Owner or lead of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sil3
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Safety Integrity Level 3 under IEC 61508.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resolved

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iban
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) is a system for identifying bank accounts across national borders standardized by [ISO 13616](https://www.iso.org/standard/81090.html). It consists of up to 34 alphanumeric characters, including a country code, two check digits, and a basic bank account number. While spaces may be inserted for human readability, they must be omitted when used for electronic data exchange (e.g., `IE64IRCE92050112345678`).
Provide consumers with comments by the creator of the Element about the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isil
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Identifier for Libraries and Related Organizations (ISIL)](https://slks.dk/english/work-areas/libraries-and-literature/library-standards/isil/) is a unique alphanumeric code for identifying libraries, archives, museums, and related organizations standardized by [ISO 15511](https://www.iso.org/standard/77849.html). It consists of a prefix—which may be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or a non-country code assigned by the ISIL Registration Authority—followed by a unit identifier, totaling up to 16 characters (e.g., `FI-Sipoo-Sö` or `ZDB-1-SBD`). Valid symbols include any alphanumeric character, solidus (`/`), hyphen-minus (`-`), or colon.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: observation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Documentation of direct monitoring or witnessing of the demonstration of processes, tests, or any kind of system responses during a specified timeframe under specified environmental conditions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: generates
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element generates each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: decommission

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b512

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directory

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eori
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/customs-procedures-import-and-export/customs-operations/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-number-eori_en) is a unique identifier for businesses undertaking customs operations across European Union customs territory, such as import, export, and transit. rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDistributionArtifact

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe23

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trackStar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: ("Track\*" in the SSVC spec) The vulnerability contains specific characteristics that may require closer monitoring for changes. CISA recommends remediating Track\* vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). Link to the project contract.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cycle

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Identifier (IBID)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a verifiable unique identifier for legal entities as defined in the [ISO/DIS 25500-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/87705.html) draft standard. rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
